scope: Local streaming ASR transport and finalization only; no model/provider change.
timing_mode: as-fast-as-possible existing asr-bench, including its per-chunk idle polling, warm shared model, debug Rust/native prebuilt optimized inference; not microphone latency
normalization: Unicode lowercase; drop punctuation, collapse whitespace; CER excludes spaces; English WER uses whitespace words. Existing raw case-sensitive CER is retained under cer.
limitations: 10 original utterances, only one Mandarin sample and two English speakers; not a representative speech accuracy estimate.
One additional derived tail-trimmed Mandarin stress sample is excluded from original-corpus totals.
Originals and derived sample reused identically for both variants.
Baseline batch precedes candidate batch; shared cloud CPU and two repetitions limit timing interpretation.
No Windows microphone hardware measured; no overall speedup established.
Silence/noise controls retain existing empty-transcript connection-close behavior.
Model-backed validation covers only the pinned Zipformer; Paraformer and other optional model effects are unmeasured.
